crossRefs.note: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with them…
You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all…
crossRefs.keyword: unto all generations. Heb. to generation and generation

crossRefs.note: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
crossRefs.keyword: unto all generations. Heb. to generation and generation

crossRefs.note: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
crossRefs.keyword: unto all generations. Heb. to generation and generation

crossRefs.note: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be…
He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
“Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
For this they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by…

translations.web: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
translations.bsb: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
translations.kjv: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
translations.asv: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: Thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
